_note: 할로우 전면 교체 — 프랍·영지 건물. 한 장에 물체 하나.

rulesets.p: Hollow Knight inspired hand-drawn 2D game art: clean smooth dark linework, muted desaturated palette, soft painterly cel shading, bug-like chibi proportions, melancholic fairy-tale tone. NOT pixel art, NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D-rendered. A SINGLE object centered, 3/4 top-down quarter view. Cut off cleanly at its own base. NO ground, floor, grass, shadow. Background: completely flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF. No text, no labels, no borders.
